name: Tile Blast
description: The first clip breaks into square tiles that blast toward the viewer from a point, tumbling and growing as they fly out, uncovering the second. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Point the tiles blast away from (0..1, y down)

params.name: spin
params.description: How much the tiles spin and tumble

params.name: shading
params.description: How much the tiles darken as they turn, and their shadows
